description: Fix EXECUTE_NORMALIZED AttributeError for WhatDreamsCost custom nodes (LTXDirector, LTXDirectorGuide, LTXDirectorCropGuides) by using the standard ComfyUI FUNCTION class attribute pattern.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix build_director_conditioning: Replace EXECUTE_NORMALIZED call with FUNCTION-based dispatch for LTXDirector node. Read node_cls.FUNCTION attribute to get the actual method name, call that via getattr.
STEP 2 - Fix run_director_guide: Replace EXECUTE_NORMALIZED/execute fallback pattern with FUNCTION-based dispatch for LTXDirectorGuide node.
STEP 3 - Fix run_director_crop_guides: Replace EXECUTE_NORMALIZED/execute fallback pattern with FUNCTION-based dispatch for LTXDirectorCropGuides node.
STEP 4 - Keep LTXVCropGuides (core node) using EXECUTE_NORMALIZED as-is since it is a core ComfyUI node that supports that method.
acceptance_criteria: Python file passes py_compile and ast.parse without errors
All three WhatDreamsCost node calls use getattr(cls, 'FUNCTION') pattern
Graceful fallback to EXECUTE_NORMALIZED if FUNCTION attribute is not defined
Error handling catches both TypeError and AttributeError
LTXVCropGuides fallback (core node) still uses EXECUTE_NORMALIZED
findings: Fixed the root cause of the AttributeError. WhatDreamsCost custom nodes do not implement EXECUTE_NORMALIZED (which is a ComfyUI core method). Instead, they follow the standard ComfyUI pattern where the node class defines FUNCTION = 'method_name' as a class attribute. The fix reads this attribute and calls the correct method via getattr. Falls back to EXECUTE_NORMALIZED only for core nodes that lack the FUNCTION attribute.
